bail_climb_out.about: Bailing out of the commander's hatch: stood in it (his boots 0.92 m under the tank's `commander` socket, the rim 1.17 m over them, as commander_hatch), both hands on the rim; a boot up on the seat (0.30 m) and the other on a foothold higher inside (0.70 m), heaved up on his arms and over the rim, his hands onto the roof, his right knee onto the roof beside the hatch (0.95 m over where his boots began) and his left boot out, and up on the roof, crouched, looking to his right. Root motion: the root under his boots, up 0.95 m, 0.47 m to his right and 0.10 m forward (on a roof higher or lower than 0.95 m over the turret's floor, add the difference to his height from 0.6 s on).

bail_step_down.about: Down off the turret: stood at the edge of the turret's roof facing out (its edge 0.14 m ahead of his boots), he steps off it (off at 0.10 s), drops the 0.95 m onto the hull's deck (touching down at 0.55 s) and lands on bent knees, his left hand back onto the turret's edge (the roof at his shoulder then) to steady him. Root motion: the root under his boots, from the turret's roof to the deck, 0.95 m down and 0.42 m forward. From a higher or lower turret roof, add the difference to his height between 0.10 and 0.55 s.

bail_jump_down.about: Down off the tank: stood at the edge of the deck, he crouches (deepest at 0.26 s), jumps out and down the 1.5 m (off the edge at 0.44 s, touching down at 1.09 s) with his knees drawn up, lands deep on bent knees with his right hand going down to the ground, and comes up into his first running stride. Root motion: the root under his boots, from the deck's edge to the ground, 1.5 m down and 1.71 m forward. From a higher or lower deck, add the difference to his height between 0.44 and 1.09 s.

burning_run.about: Running on fire, a loop of three strides (2.1 s, 7.35 m: the game moves him, 3.5 m a second): his hands at his face, then the left there and the right beating at his chest, then both flung up and flailing; bent forward, his head down and shaking. In place: `stride` 7.35.

burning_fall_roll.about: On fire, from burning_run's first frame: he stumbles, falls forward onto his hands and knees and onto his front, rolls over one and a half times to his right (stop, drop and roll), writhes on his back, kicking and beating at himself, and lies still by 3.3 s. Root motion: the ground under his pelvis (0.95 m ahead, 1.20 m to his right at the end).
